signature.name: VTask.map
signature.type: {n : Type u} -> [DecidableEq n] -> [Fintype n] -> {R : Type v} -> [CommRing R] -> {S : Type u_1} -> [CommRing S] -> (f : R →+* S) -> Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup n R →* Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup n S

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: This is a total algebraic construction with no junk-value inputs or degenerate boundary conventions; every ring homomorphism between commutative rings yields a well-defined group homomorphism between the corresponding special linear groups.

facts.statement: ∀ (n : Type*) [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (S : Type*) [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S), VTask.map f 1 = 1

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (n : Type*) [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (S : Type*) [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (g h : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup n R), VTask.map f (g * h) = VTask.map f g * VTask.map f h

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (n : Type*) [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (S : Type*) [CommRing S] (T : Type*) [CommRing T] (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T), VTask.map (g.comp f) = (VTask.map g).comp (VTask.map f)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (n : Type*) [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (S : Type*) [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S), Function.Injective f → Function.Injective (VTask.map f : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup n R → Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup n S)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (n : Type*) [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (S : Type*) [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup n R), Matrix.det ((VTask.map f g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup n S) : Matrix n n S) = 1

facts.statement: ¬ (∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (S : Type*) [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S), Function.Surjective (VTask.map f : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) R → Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) S))
